title: Windows merge tests read git's forward-slash paths
why: Main's push run stays red until the Windows merge tests compare paths the way git prints them.
note: Status, Oct 26: #609 merged; ready to close. Result: test-only fix. A tree_listed helper in merge/test_merge.py compares realpath plus normcase on both sides; merge.py's remove_held_tree already compared realpath on both sides, so no product defect. Proof: red on main run 40325058256 (5 Windows merge shards), green on gates dispatch 40332792660 (all jobs).
